rather than identifying either with a two-dimensional exclusion sensor.

on a circle of circumference N. Let X_y be the vector of lifted positions,
V_y their velocities, and let the actual unknown smooth potential satisfy

\[
 U_N(X_1+c_1\mathbf1,\ldots,X_N+c_N\mathbf1)=U_N(X_1,\ldots,X_N)
                                                               \tag{1}
\]

for independent row translations. The potential can be nonharmonic and can
couple relative coordinates in different rows. Its actual interactions,
spatial range and force bounds belong to the native material; (1) does not
grant an instantaneous nonlocal force. A local row potential is a concrete
subclass. Arbitrary forces between particles in different translating rows
do not satisfy (1) automatically.

# Downstream native-event readout: exact source preservation and a volume-scale loss boundary

30 October 2026. Complementary constructive opportunity, record_geometry.

## 1. The actual stronger port

An existing outgoing record can be measured after it has left the native
system. This is a useful ordinary alternative to contacting the native
positions with a new reciprocal sensor. It is not a claim that every
particle hop already emits an accessible record.

Assume the actual native dynamics has local marked events. An event carries
its physical row and horizontal displacement sign, and already emits a
distinguishable outgoing quantum or other physical signal with that mark.
The emission is part of the reference dynamics. The outgoing channel is
strictly one way: changes of its downstream load do not change the native
input, Hamiltonian, transition rates or noise. Native and deployment use
the same source and channel; only the downstream record is used to drive
the isolated auxiliary apparatus.

The native state may contain arbitrary hidden memory. Conditional on that
state and the full past, the total intensity of the relevant unit events
is at most Lambda N^2. No native jump rate is learned. A single event
affects at most a fixed number of local current components.

This port can preserve the source exactly. The ordinary physical precedent
is cascaded quantum input--output theory. With source A, receiver B,
source operator L_A, receiver operator L_B, and

\[
H_{\rm cas}=\frac{L_B^\dagger L_A-L_A^\dagger L_B}{2i},
\]

the cascade generator is

\[
\mathcal L\rho
=-i[H_A+H_B+H_{\rm cas},\rho]+\mathcal D[L_A+L_B]\rho.
                                                               \tag{1}
\]

Here D[L]rho=L rho L^dagger-{L^dagger L,rho}/2. For any observable O_A
on the source, the cross terms in the dissipator are

\[
\tfrac12[L_A^\dagger,O_A]L_B
+\tfrac12L_B^\dagger[O_A,L_A].
\]

They cancel i[H_cas,O_A] exactly. Thus

\[
\mathcal L^\dagger(O_A\otimes I_B)
=(\mathcal L_A^\dagger O_A)\otimes I_B.                        \tag{2}
\]

The reduced source evolution is autonomous for every initial joint state.
Repeating this argument between source interventions preserves its
operational multitime statistics. A finite propagation delay does not
create upstream influence in an actually one-way field channel; equation
(1) is the usual zero-delay Markov representation.

# A richer emitted record removes the fixed-loss current floor

30 October 2026. Existing record_geometry role. This is a constructive
strengthening of the downstream readout comparison, at a different
explicit record interface.

## 1. Native physics and extra observable information

There are at most C N^2 native particles on N horizontal circles of
circumference N. Each particle remains in its row. A native elementary
move is one lattice step clockwise or counterclockwise. Interactions,
hidden states and time-dependent kinetics are allowed, provided the total
conditional native event intensity is at most Lambda N^2.

The actual outgoing event port is one way and already part of the native
reference, as in DOWNSTREAM_EVENT_READOUT_AND_VOLUME_PRECISION.md.
Now a detected event additionally identifies the native particle and its
wrapped position immediately after the event. Its emission time or
causal ordering is available. Detection is independent across emissions
conditional on the complete native path, with efficiency at least a
fixed eta_0>0. The efficiency need not be known and need not tend to one.

Static particle tags, distinguishable position labels, timing and a
nonreturning output channel are real extra observable resources.
They are not inferred from an anonymous current pulse or from a native
Markov generator. In particular, the count-only fixed-loss obstruction
does not apply to this richer record.

## 2. A causal estimator requiring no initial microscopic position

For each particle, discard its motion before its first detected position.
Retain that position. Whenever its next position is detected, add the
shortest signed lattice arc from the previous detected position to the
new one to the estimated physical current. Use a fixed convention for
an exact half-circle tie.

The estimator is causal in the ordered detected record. It does not
simulate a missing native future or require a native rate estimate.
It also does not need an initial position measurement: the omitted
initial segment is accounted for below.

Let K be the number of actual native steps between two successive
detected positions. If K<N/2, the actual unwrapped endpoint displacement
has magnitude less than N/2 and is recovered exactly. If K>=N/2, the
difference between the true endpoint displacement and the short-arc
choice is a multiple of N, with magnitude at most 2K.
